observations: Photo 0 shows a black Xbox 360 console held in hand, with 'XBOX 360' visible on the front panel. Surrounding it are several game cases, including 'Assassin's Creed 2', 'Batman 2', 'Disney Infinity', and 'FIFA Legends'.

Photo 1 shows a white Xbox 360 controller with grey cables wrapped around it. The controller has the standard Xbox 360 layout: two analog sticks, four colored buttons (red, green, blue, yellow), and a central guide button. The controller appears to be in used condition with some visible wear.
Photo 2 shows the back of the console, which also has 'XBOX 360' embossed on the surface. The back panel has visible dust and minor scuffs. The console is placed on a bed with game cases around it.
